description: This file defines the LeavePeriodDao class, a Data Access Object responsible for handling leave period history persistence, retrieval, and related transactions in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It manages database operations such as saving leave period history, fetching the current leave period, and retrieving the leave period history list.

classes.name: LeavePeriodDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for managing leave period history records in the database, supporting transactions and retrieval functions.

methods.name: saveLeavePeriodHistory
methods.description: Persists a LeavePeriodHistory object into the database after handling transaction management and triggering leave entitlement strategy adjustments if necessary.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent LeavePeriodHistory record, ordered by creation date and ID, representing the current leave period start date and month.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Fetches a list of all LeavePeriodHistory records ordered by creation date and ID.
